review_comment: I would actually suggest splitting out the -1 change. It will require some more thought (and references to documentation), vs the simple and clear bugfix of calling the wrong method.
`UNKNOWN` doesn't seem right. -1 means "no limit", not "unknown", according to [the docs](https://man.archlinux.org/man/limits.conf.5).

Actually I don't think this fix is right. The value -1 should not be reaching this code per the javadocs on [`getRLimit`](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/blob/53d8cc35694d2d14596d322878e780ed869610f1/libs/native/src/main/java/org/elasticsearch/nativeaccess/PosixNativeAccess.java#L54).
